Finally completed it. 🎓
After going through a lot of starting, stopping, learning, getting stuck, and coming back to it, I can finally say that I’ve completed ALPHA by [****Apna College****](https://www.linkedin.com/company/apna-college/).
I started this course just to learn Programming and DSA, but along the way, it became much more than just another course on the internet.
There were days when I was consistent, and there were days when I barely opened it. 😅
But somehow, I kept coming back to it.
Today, seeing that completion certificate honestly feels a little different. Not because it’s just a certificate, but because I know the journey it took to get here.
A small milestone, but an important one for me.
Now it’s time to turn all that learning into actual skills. 🚀
One course completed. A lot more to learn.
